title: Ticket
description: A sent ticket: the allergens it forbids and the clean-confidence a plate needs. One row of the ticket table, which keeps the latest revision. Severity, trace sensitivity and exceptions stay in the draft (parse_result). Producer: orders. Consumers: verdict, partner graph, outputs.

number.description: Short number spoken by the gate, e.g. 7 for "Hold seven".

revision.description: Bumped on every amendment. A verdict is tied to one revision.

pass_threshold.description: Minimum clean-confidence required to pass. Orders sets it from the strictest severity on the ticket (AGENTS.md, Open questions: pass thresholds).

forbidden.description: Forbidden allergens. Never forbidden contacts (safety rule: allergens, not contacts).
